channel.title: Pier & Point · Correction
channel.description: Correction changes and milestones, for four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens: The status line 'since about…
item.description: The status line 'since about Aug 2018' came from an SF Chronicle piece that said Parklab Gardens was 'opening Friday', a report written before the opening. An opening needs a source written after it. The line now rests on Hoodline's report, published August 20, 2018, that Stagecoach Greens, which OCII's November 2024 legend places on P15, 'is now open'. The month stays approximate because that report gives no opening day. No source written after the opening was found for Parklab Gardens, so it has no opening date here. Source: Hoodline, "Now open in Mission Bay: SF's first outdoor mini-golf course" (Aug 20, 2018, https://hoodline.com/2018/08/now-open-in-mission-bay-sf-s-first-outdoor-mini-golf-course/): "San Francisco’s first outdoor mini-golf course, Stagecoach Greens, is now open at 1379 4th St. in Mission Bay."; OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, Nov 14, 2024 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf), PDF p.17 legend: "P15 Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens".
item.source: Hoodline, "Now open in Mission Bay: SF's first outdoor mini-golf course" (Aug 20, 2018, https://hoodline.com/2018/08/now-open-in-mission-bay-sf-s-first-outdoor-mini-golf-course/): "San Francisco’s first outdoor mini-golf course, Stagecoach Greens, is now open at 1379 4th St. in Mission Bay."; OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, Nov 14, 2024 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf), PDF p.17 legend: "P15 Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens"

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens: The 2026-09-24 retail row…
item.description: The 2026-09-24 retail row 'SPARK Social SF operates at 601 Mission Bay Blvd North' was filed on this record when it covered all three west Commons parcels. OCII's November 2024 legend puts SPARK Social SF on P13 ("P13 Community Garden & SPARK Social SF"), so the tenant is now listed on the P13 record, and the entry on this page is not about a P15 tenant. Another page of the same deck (PDF p.31) groups "P13 & P15: Food Truck Park with Outdoor Dining (SPARK Social SF & Parklab Gardens)"; this page follows the legend. Source: OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, Nov 14, 2024 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf), PDF p.17 legend: "P13 Community Garden & SPARK Social SF".

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens: The one record for the three…
item.description: The one record for the three west Commons parcels is now three, one per parcel, each named for its parcel and the uses OCII's November 2024 update lists on it. This record keeps its address history and now covers parcel P15 (Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens) only, between 4th St and 3rd St. Its shape was the whole Parklab park strip from OpenStreetMap; it is now that strip's P15 part, cut at 4th St along DataSF's street centerline plus 6.8 m, and is marked approximate because the parcel lines are drawn from OCII's drawing, not surveyed. P15 has no Assessor lot of its own. The old page address redirects here, and the old names still find it in search. Source: OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, Nov 14, 2024 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf), PDF p.17 legend: "P12 SFF Soccer + Fitness Court", "P13 Community Garden & SPARK Social SF", "P15 Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens".
item.source: OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, Nov 14, 2024 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf), PDF p.17 legend: "P12 SFF Soccer + Fitness Court", "P13 Community Garden & SPARK Social SF", "P15 Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens"

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 15 / Station A: The City's Legistar pages list the…
item.description: The City's Legistar pages list the amended development agreement (File 260724) and its zoning ordinance (File 260770) as approved by the Mayor and enacted on October 13, 2026 (Enactment Nos. 208-26 and 209-26). The Board gave the ordinances final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes), per the Clerk of the Board's certificate in each file's 'Leg Final' attachment. The summary, an open question and the September 29 timeline entry still said enactment was not confirmed or still to come; they now match the Legistar pages. Both ordinances say 'This ordinance shall become effective on the 31st day after enactment' (File 260770 §5(a) and File 260724, in each file's 'Leg Final' attachment), which makes November 13, 2026 the effective date by our count, a legal date computed by Pier & Point and not printed in the text; the heights and uses in the enacted text are not yet checked against this record. The record's timeline now has an entry for the Board's final passage on October 6, 2026 (11 ayes), before the Mayor's approval.
